he: שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃
en: A song of ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the mountains: from whence shall my help come?

he: עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
en: My help is from Havayah, Who made heaven and earth.
He shall not suffer your foot to be moved; He that keeps you shall not slumber.

he: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
en: Behold, He that keeps Yisrael shall neither slumber nor sleep.

he: יְהֹוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
en: Havayah is your keeper; Havayah is your shade upon your right hand.
The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night.
Havayah shall keep you from all evil; He shall keep your soul.
Havayah shall guard your going out and your coming in, from this time forth and forevermore.
